scientific_integrity: All counts and orbits arise from full exact exhaustive codebook enumeration, directly checked; two standalone independent implementations and a canonical catalogue are supplied. No claim of publication, authorship, or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive finite theorem for the seven-cycle confusability channel with two uses; no asymptotic extrapolation; maximal-set spectrum is new claim, not known minimum 7 or known maximum 10 and 980 attaining sets. One 2005 full text remained inaccessible; earlier unindexed catalogue cannot be excluded. Independent audit not performed.
title: The complete saturation spectrum of two-use seven-cycle zero-error codes
